note: Long Distance has no score yet: the author has not decided whether there is one. This file is the hook. tools/build_mix.py places every cue listed here into the bed (out/mix/bed.flac) on the film's clock, under the voices (the bed is ducked under them by mix.py), and the world's silences do not silence it, so a cue can carry the title. An empty list builds the film without music. When a score is wanted, spot it against the moments below, generate the takes (audio/score/<id>.wav|flac|mp3; Lyria via a lyria.py copied from autopilot, or the author's own), and add cues; nothing else changes.

cue_format.level_db: -15 = the house level (the take is normalised to -23 LUFS, then level_db + 9 dB)
cue_format.from_s: where in the take to start (window past its intro)

silences_to_keep: Q10 51.5-55 s (global 422-425.5): the room drops out as the screen goes dark; music here would undo it
Q11 11 s (global 464): the app opens with no sound at all; nothing dials, nothing rings
Q11 58-72 s (global 511-525): the black and the title are silent, unless the score's last note is decided to carry the title
